{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","@id":"https://signalmash.com/toll-free-messaging#faq","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"Do I need to verify my toll-free number for messaging?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Yes. Toll-free verification is a one-time review by the toll-free aggregator that confirms your business identity, use case and opt-in process. Unverified toll-free numbers are heavily filtered or blocked; once approved, your messages are far less likely to be filtered and can be sent at higher throughput, as long as content stays compliant."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Can I use my existing toll-free number for SMS?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Yes.
